title: Hruday continuum-trajectory statement: the one uniform estimate the fixed-spacing family supplies and the one it fails to supply
selection_reason: Roadmap goal 5 needs the regulator/coupling dictionary along a trajectory and an honest identification of which uniform estimate is available. The AL1 dictionary tau=96/g^4 places the admitted regime at g^4>=9.6x10^9 at fixed spacing; asymptotic freedom sends g->0 as a->0, where the strong-coupling expansion fails.
model: The uniform Kogut-Susskind SU(2) family (AX1) along a named trajectory (a_n,g_n); E_star fixed; no plateau fit.

parameters.trajectory: (a_n, g_n) with g_n -> 0 as a_n -> 0 (asymptotic-freedom form, stated as a hypothesis, not derived here)
parameters.supplied: volume-uniform gap alpha/16=g^2/(32a) for g^4>=9.6x10^9 at fixed a
parameters.failed: any estimate uniform along a_n->0: the AM2 contraction needs tau<=10^-8 i.e. g^4>=9.6x10^9, violated on every g->0 path; the AL1 bridge condition g^4>=32 also fails

required: 1. Name the trajectory and apply the dictionary; locate the admitted regime; 2. identify exactly one necessary uniform estimate and prove or cite that the fixed-spacing family supplies it (the volume-uniform gap at fixed a) and state its failure point on the trajectory; 3. retain the AL1 bridge obstruction and the failure of common rescaling; 4. state what a continuum construction would additionally require (uniform-in-a estimates, reconstruction hypotheses, physical scale control) with the missing premise for each; 5. exact checker for the dictionary arithmetic and the guard controls; skeptic review; no number is a fraction of the continuum problem.
